title: The product host serves the workspace and no marketing pages

comments.author: home
comments.text:
As a Chatticus user, I want hey.chattic.us/ to be the workspace, so that the
product host has no marketing content left in it after the split.

**Blocked by:** S1 (marketing verified live on its own domain).
**Unblocks:** DNS cutover (task 11).

---
Feature: Product host after the marketing split

  Scenario: The root path serves the workspace unconditionally
    Given the marketing pages have been removed from web/
    When a browser requests https://hey.chattic.us/
    Then the response is the chat workspace, with no host-based branching

  Scenario: Marketing routes are gone from the product build
    Given the product web app has been rebuilt
    Then /features/*, /contact/*, /waitlist/*, and /beta return 404

**Done when:** the CloudFront function's host-based `/` rewrite is removed and
only the generic extensionless-path SPA rewrite remains.
